name: new_dinner_price
description: No account files. The person asks for the price of dinner a guest to be remembered, it is saved, and later in the same conversation they give a different price: the harness compares it with what was saved, opens an earlier finding, and the person decides.
lines: Please remember that dinner at the wedding is 230 a guest.
The caterer has just told me that dinner is 250 a guest, not 230. Please save the new price.
